components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action: Open the map, download results.json.

components.html: <fieldset class="ds-choice"><label class="ds-on"><input type="radio" name="r" checked>La Paz</label><label><input type="radio" name="r">Full scene</label></fieldset>
components.css: .ds-choice { border: 0; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-choice label { border: 1px solid #8E928A; margin: 0 -1px -1px 0; padding: 0.35rem 0.65rem; font-size: 0.86rem; background: #F5F6F1; color: #1F2421; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-choice label:hover { background: #ECEDE6; } .ds-choice label.ds-on { background: #1F2421; border-color: #1F2421; color: #F5F6F1; position: relative; z-index: 1; } .ds-choice label:focus-within { outline: 2px solid #9A4B2C; outline-offset: 2px; z-index: 2; } .ds-choice input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: View Tabs
components.description: Five numbered views with a siena underline on the active tab.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; border-top: 1px solid #E1E3DA; background: #F5F6F1; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav button { font: inherit; font-size: 0.9rem; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid #E1E3DA; background: transparent; color: #4A524E; padding: 0.55rem 0.9rem 0.45rem; cursor: pointer; position: relative; transition: color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-nav button::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0.9rem; right: 0.9rem; bottom: 0; height: 3px; background: #9A4B2C; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-nav button:hover { color: #1F2421; } .ds-nav button.ds-on { color: #1F2421; font-weight: 650; } .ds-nav button.ds-on::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #9A4B2C; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-step { display: inline-block; width: 1.4em; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.78rem; color: #9A4B2C; }

narrative.overview:
The site is a survey sheet of one radar observation. Every surface reads as part of a printed topographic sheet: a cool grey-green map paper, a thin black neatline doubled by an offset outline, legend cells ruled like a map margin, and provenance printed as marginalia beside the plate it describes. It deliberately refuses the dark mission-control look that satellite projects ship; the only dark field on the site is the AI hero, and it is dark because it is a photograph-like illustration, not because the brand is.

Density is low on the cover (one monumental figure per scroll beat) and moderate in the five map views, where a fixed 400px side margin carries text, controls and tables beside a full-height map. The voice is sober: wide, spaced Archivo capitals name the sheet; ordinary Archivo carries the reading; JetBrains Mono appears only where a surveyor would print machine strings (granule ids, EPSG, CRID).

Honesty is a visual rule, not only a copy rule. What is illustration is labelled as illustration on the image itself, what is data names its source on the image itself, and the switch between the two is drawn from the real terrain.
keyCharacteristics: Cool map paper ground with a faint, slowly breathing contour field behind everything.
Neatlines: 1px pizarra or ink border plus a 1px outline offset 3 to 5px; 3px double rules for sheet margins.
One action colour (siena), one marker colour (ocre), one structure colour (pizarra).
Data colours come from `results.json` and live only inside data: plates, swatches, bars, colour ramps.
Square corners everywhere except a 2px softening on buttons.
Scroll-scrubbed cover with a DEM-driven contour handover; static, fully legible fallback behind five media gates.

rules.name: The Data Ink Rule
rules.body: Data colours appear only inside data: map layers, plates, swatches, proportion bars and colour bars. They are never reused as UI colour, and UI colours never enter a data legend.

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Siena is reserved for what can be acted on or is currently active (buttons, the download, the active tab, focus). It is never a fill for surfaces or a decoration for headings.

rules.name: The Cool Paper Rule
rules.body: The ground is grey-green map paper (#ECEDE6 family), never cream, never dark. Darkness exists only inside the AI hero.

rules.name: The Marginalia Mono Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is used only for machine strings a survey sheet prints in its margin: granule ids, CRID, EPSG, grid spacing, tick values. Never for headings, buttons or prose.

rules.name: The Locale Number Rule
rules.body: Every number is formatted with the UI locale (es-BO decimal comma in Spanish, en-US in English) and set with tabular figures in tables and figures. Phase is labelled and shown in radians, never converted to displacement.

rules.name: The Five Gates Rule
rules.body: The scroll-scrubbed hero turns into a static, fully set hero under any of five media gates: max-width 720px; portrait up to 1024px; portrait coarse pointer; landscape coarse pointer under 560px tall; prefers-reduced-motion. The gate strings are identical in CSS and in Cover.tsx and must stay so. Under 960px the handover shows the final real layer with the NISAR label and stacks its beats.

rules.name: The Neatline Rule
rules.body: A framed thing gets a neatline (border plus offset outline), never a drop shadow or a card lift.

dos: Do label any illustrative image on the image itself, in the footer and in its file metadata; the AI hero carries "AI-generated illustration · not data" on screen.
Do name the actual source on each layer's chip: the DEM on relief, NISAR only on NISAR layers, and switch away from "illustration" only when no illustration pixel remains.
Do frame plates, maps, legends and marginalia with a neatline (1px border plus 1px outline offset 3 to 5px) and close sheet margins with a 3px double pizarra rule.
Do format numbers in the UI locale (es-BO decimal comma) with tabular figures, and show phase in radians.
Do keep the five static-hero gate strings identical in CSS and script.
donts: Don't reuse the state colours (#0072B2, #D55E00, #F0E442, #999999) or any data ramp as UI colour.
Don't use siena for surfaces, headings or decoration; it marks actions and the active state.
Don't print coordinates, grid or EPSG on the AI hero; located marginalia start at the real plate.
Don't set headings, buttons or prose in JetBrains Mono.
Don't use drop shadows, card lifts or rounded containers; depth is ruled, corners are square.
Don't move to a dark or cream ground outside the hero.
